reckless-abandon.name: Reckless Abandon
reckless-abandon.text: Pay any number of resources. Lose X Influence: one of your units gets +X Power and Breakthrough this round.
reckless-abandon.designerNote:
2026-07-13 (designer, issue #45): "Pay any number of resources and lose X influence to give one
unit +X strength and breakthrough." The game's first X card — new vocabulary: `cost: X` in the
frontmatter, the declared X flows into the effect. Name and art (borrowed from Reckless Charge)
are agent picks, ⚑ freely rename/re-art.

⚑ Agent assumptions to ratify or veto: the pump and Breakthrough last **this round** (red's pump
grammar); the target is **friendly**; **X=0 is legal** (a free Breakthrough rider); **2 red pips**
(a scaling finisher reads deep-red, though the cost-tier grammar has no row for X); single copy
in Crimson Assault (an X finisher isn't a ≤2-cost workhorse for the doubles rule).

modes.label: Charge
modes.text: Move one of your units one zone, even if exhausted — this doesn't exhaust it.

modes.label: Pack fury
modes.text: Target unit gets +1 Power this round for each other red unit in its zone (either side's).

reckless-charge.name: Reckless Charge
reckless-charge.text: Choose one — move one of your units one zone, even if exhausted (this doesn't exhaust it); OR target unit gets +1 Power this round for each other red unit in its zone (either side's).
reckless-charge.designerNote:
Session 006: was "gains Rush" permanently — dead text under decision 41 (Rush only matters the round a unit enters play, so a permanent grant on a veteran does nothing, ever). Now scoped to the round: the real play is on a unit you just dropped — its first move becomes free, so it can cross a zone and still fight.

2026-07-11 (designer, PR #13 + #14): cost 1 → 0 and became modal — the second mode is the pack-fury
pump counting ALL red units in the zone, enemy red included (rage recognizes rage). First modal card
in the game; the mode is declared when you cast.

2026-07-12 (designer, issue #26 → decision 72): the round-scoped Rush grant was STILL dead on any
unit from an earlier round (the free move only exists the round a unit entered) and useless on an
exhausted unit (it can't move at all). Mode rebuilt in the designer's own words: an immediate
one-zone lunge, exhausted or not, exhausting nothing. New vocabulary: op `move` + zone target
`adjacentToFirst`. A genuinely *reckless* charge — hurl a spent soldier forward.

cinder-initiate.name: Cinder Initiate
cinder-initiate.designerNote:
Decision 35: when attacking you MAY overextend for +N power; the unit takes N damage at end of round. A gamble, not a given.

2026-07-11 (v3 churn pass 1): Overextend is cut (#9); the gamble is priced in — 1/1 becomes 2/1. Red's opening jab.

devastating-strike.name: Devastating Strike
devastating-strike.text: Deal 2 damage to target unit — 3 instead if it's already damaged.
devastating-strike.designerNote:
Session 006: became unit-only. Red's burn grammar — unit-only burn deals cost+1, face-capable burn deals exactly cost (the reach is the tax). This is the efficient unit-killer; Searing Bolt is the flexible one.

2026-07-11 (designer, issue #4): finish-the-wounded clause added (2, or 3 to a damaged unit) —
first conditional-bonus card. Pairs with red's chip damage; the executioner rewards setup.

searing-bolt.name: Searing Bolt
searing-bolt.designerNote:
2026-07-11 (designer, issue #4): 2 → 3 damage at unchanged cost 2. This runs ABOVE the
session-006 burn grammar (face-capable burn = cost) — designer's call on his ratify pass;
flagged on the thread in case cost 3 was intended.

2026-07-12 (designer, PR #34): 2-mana-deal-3 → 1-mana-deal-2 — "need a cheaper card but lower
damage." Effects synced to the new text; still conforms to the red burn grammar (face-capable = cost+1).

spark-hound.name: Spark Hound
spark-hound.text: Rush. Guard. When this attacks, it gets +1 Power this round.
spark-hound.designerNote:
2026-07-12 (designer, PR #31): gains Guard — "they look like guard dogs." Note for the record:
red's charter forbids Guard ("red doesn't defend"); the designer's PR makes Spark Hound the first
sworn exception, and the charter now records it. A 1-cost 2/1 that blocks free and bites back.

berserker.name: Berserker
berserker.designerNote: 2026-07-11 (v3 churn pass 1): Overextend is cut (#9); THE Scar bearer — the wound-powered berserker is the keyword's face (decision 70 cap applies).

blood-rush.name: Blood Rush
blood-rush.text: Remove all damage from a unit you control; deal that much damage to your Home.
blood-rush.designerNote:
2026-07-11 (designer, issue #4): full rework — the wound comes home. Red's healing is a
mortgage: your champion fights on, your Home bleeds for it. First linked-amount card.

cataclysmic-charge.name: Cataclysmic Charge
cataclysmic-charge.text: Target unit gets +3 Power and Breakthrough this round.
cataclysmic-charge.designerNote: Session 006 redesign: was 6 mana for +3 Power and Rush this round — overcosted (Blood Rush gives +2 and Rush for 2) and the Rush rider was near-dead text on veterans. Now the single-target alpha strike: the Breakthrough rider makes the pump land on the base, not just the wall.

pillage.name: Pillage
pillage.designerNote: Session 006: 4 mana → 2. Utility removal was priced like a threat; yellow runs seven upgrades and red needs a real answer at a price it can pay mid-assault.

smash-through.name: Smash Through
smash-through.text: Target unit with Rush gains Breakthrough this round.

warpath.name: Warpath
warpath.text: Your units get +1 Power this round.
warpath.designerNote: Session 006 redesign: was "all friendly units gain Rush" permanently — dead text under decision 41 (see Reckless Charge). Rebuilt as the go-wide pump: 2 mana, +1 Power to the whole board for the round. Last Stand (+2 and a blood price) is its big sibling.

bloodfrenzy.name: Bloodfrenzy
bloodfrenzy.text: Attached unit gets +1 Power and Armor 1. At the start of your round, if you have 10 or less life, attached unit gets +1 Power permanently.
bloodfrenzy.designerNote:
Session 006: threshold 5 → 10 life and cost 5 → 3. At ≤5 life the game is usually already decided; half-life is where red's desperation engine should start paying.

2026-07-11 (designer, issue #4): immediate +1 Power / Armor 1 on attach added; the ≤10-life
desperation engine unchanged. Threshold kept at "10 or less" (established) though the request
said "less than 10" — flagged on the thread.

collateral-damage.name: Collateral Damage
collateral-damage.text: Deal 2 damage to two different target units.

fiery-impaler.name: Fiery Impaler
fiery-impaler.text: When this attacks a unit, it also deals 1 damage to a unit of your choice in the same zone. If that unit dies, gain +1 influence.
fiery-impaler.designerNote:
Session 006: text now states the deterministic pick (decision 51) instead of the vague "an adjacent unit".

2026-07-13 (designer, PR #46 → decision 93): the pick becomes a CHOICE — declared with the attack
(decision 24 stands: no mid-resolution input), any unit in the combat zone except the declared
target, "even your own" (friendly fire is deliberate, and red — Scar synergy is legal). A kill by
the skewer reaps 1 influence. New vocabulary: op `splashReap`, attack-action `splash` declarations.
⚑ Agent rulings within the door: the skewer can't hit the attack's own target (the text says
"ALSO deals"); ready enemy Hidden units refuse the choice (decision 76); no candidates → the
trigger fizzles and the attack proceeds.

rageforged-brute.name: Rageforged Brute
rageforged-brute.designerNote: 2026-07-11 (v3 churn pass 1): Overextend is cut (#9); stat comp instead of a second keyword — 4/3 becomes 4/4.

volcanic-slam.name: Volcanic Slam
volcanic-slam.text: Deal 3 damage to up to two units in the same zone.
volcanic-slam.designerNote:
2026-07-11 (designer, issue #4): one eruption, one zone — trades face-reach for a second body.
First upTo/sameZone card. Under decision 68's curve a 3-cost dealing up to 6 across two bodies
is the convex rate red wants.

blaze-juggernaut.name: Blaze Juggernaut
blaze-juggernaut.designerNote:
Reach (canon since v2.0 audit): may attack into an adjacent zone like Ranged, but unlike Ranged it can assault bases and does take counter-damage.

2026-07-11 (v3 churn pass 4): Reach is cut (#8, designer-confirmed). The juggernaut stops poking over walls and starts going through them: Rush + Breakthrough (the printed 2 died with decision 75 — all excess spills).

burning-oath.name: Burning Oath
burning-oath.text: Attached unit gets +2 Power and Breakthrough.
burning-oath.designerNote: Session 006 redesign: was +2 Power and Rush — the Rush half was dead text on any unit already in play (decision 41). Breakthrough keeps the oath aggressive and permanent.

doombringer.name: Doombringer
doombringer.designerNote: Session 006 balance pass: 5 → 4 mana (sim-guided red curve compression; a hot statline for the cost — watch it in play).

execution-swing.name: Execution Swing
execution-swing.designerNote: Session 006: 6 mana → 4. Legal under the red charter as the "finish the fight" execute — it requires combat to have happened first (damaged-only); red still never gets unconditional destroy.

inferno-titan.name: Inferno Titan
inferno-titan.designerNote:
Session 006: 6/5 → 5/4. It beat the statline grammar by +3 while carrying two keywords — the pool's most undercosted body.

2026-07-11 (v3 churn pass 1): Overextend is cut (#9); Scar replaces the gamble: a 5/4 that grows angrier as it burns (max +2 at 2 damage).

rupture.name: Rupture
rupture.text: Deal 4 damage to target unit or base.

crimson-behemoth.name: Crimson Behemoth
crimson-behemoth.text: When this attacks a base, it deals 2 damage to every other unit in that zone — yours included.
crimson-behemoth.designerNote: Re-ruled after playtest 004: the assault splashes the defended Home zone, both sides (the original "adjacent zones" reading only ever hit Neutral — dead text during a siege). Session 006: 6/6 → 6/5 to sit on the statline grammar, and the text now says what actually happens.

final-onslaught.name: Final Onslaught
final-onslaught.text: Ready one of your units, then immediately take an extra action. After the action, kill this unit and any unit damaged by this unit's attack.
final-onslaught.designerNote: Decision 43: rounds have no extra turns — "extra turn" became ready one of your units + an extra action. Unplayable with no friendly unit to ready, by design.

relentless-assault.name: Relentless Assault
relentless-assault.designerNote: Session 006: retexted from "take an extra combat phase" (a phase that no longer exists — decision 40 dissolved the phase ladder). The effect was already ready-all; now the card says so.

warlord-garok.name: Warlord Garok
warlord-garok.text: Rush. Your other units have +1 Power.
warlord-garok.designerNote: Session 006 balance pass: 6 → 5 mana (sim-guided red curve compression).

burn-the-frontline.name: Burn the Frontline
burn-the-frontline.text: Choose a zone. Deal 6 damage to every unit there — yours included.
burn-the-frontline.designerNote: Session 006: was 7 mana for 4 damage in one zone — strictly worse than Scorching Howl (5 mana, 3 damage everywhere). Now the wall-breaker: 6 mana, 6 damage to one zone, both sides. Kills almost every yellow wall through the fortress plan; the friendly-fire is the red cost made visible.

earthshaker.name: Earthshaker
earthshaker.designerNote: 2026-07-11 (v3 churn pass 1): Overextend is cut (#9); decision-68 curve: a 6-cost should do a lot — 6/5 becomes 7/5, plus Scar.

raging-inferno.name: Raging Inferno
raging-inferno.text: Deal 6 damage to target unit or base.
raging-inferno.designerNote: Session 006: 5 damage → 6, matching the face-capable burn grammar (damage = cost): Searing Bolt 2@2, Volcanic Slam 3@3, Rupture 4@4, Raging Inferno 6@6.

unchained-rage.name: Unchained Rage
unchained-rage.text: Double the Power of all your units for the next 2 rounds. For each unit of yours that attacks, lose 2 influence.
unchained-rage.designerNote:
2026-07-11 (designer, issue #4): from one unit, one round — to YOUR WHOLE ARMY, TWO ROUNDS.
The poster child of decision 68 (superlinear curves): this is what a 7-cost feels like.
First multi-round, board-wide effect.

apocalypse-engine.name: Apocalypse Engine
apocalypse-engine.designerNote: 2026-07-11 (v3 churn pass 1): Overextend is cut (#9); stays the pure breakthrough bomb; 7/7 becomes 8/7 (decision-68 curve).

last-stand.name: Last Stand
last-stand.text: Your units gain +2 Power this round. You lose 2 life.

worldrender.name: Worldrender
worldrender.designerNote: 2026-07-11 (v3 churn pass 1): Overextend is cut (#9); the apex predator: 9/8, Breakthrough, Scar — a wounded god hits harder (to a survivor's limit).

aura-of-resolve.name: Aura of Resolve
aura-of-resolve.text: For each friendly unit that has died or dies this round, gain 2 Life. For each enemy unit that has died or dies this round, your opponent loses 2 Life.
aura-of-resolve.designerNote:
Session 006 redesign: was "at the start of your round, gain 1 Influence" — passive income, illegal under the yellow charter (influence is event-earned, decision 34). Now it pays when the wearer defends: put it on a Guard and get paid for every intercept.

2026-07-15 (#85, Griff ratified): rebuilt from an upgrade into a **cost-0 action** that reads the day's toll. It retroactively counts every death so far this round — 2 Life to you per friendly fallen, 2 Life off the opponent per enemy fallen. Griff asked for the count to be a **reusable primitive**: a per-round death ledger now lives on the board, incremented (by owner side) at the single choke point every death flows through, cleared each round boundary — created copies that vanish (decision #69) count as deaths too. The card exposes it via a new `deathsThisRound` per-count source on the heal/damage ops (heal is uncapped, decision 104; the life-loss is ordinary base damage, respecting prevention).

iron-discipline.name: Iron Plating
iron-discipline.text: Attach to unit. This unit gets Armor 1.
iron-discipline.designerNote:
Session 006: 2 → 1 mana. As an upgrade it can be Pillaged and feeds the upgrade-pressure rule — it should undercut the action version (Radiant Aegis).

2026-07-13 (designer, PR #51 — yellow rebalance pass, issue #50): renamed Iron Discipline → Iron Plating; the on-play influence rider is cut. Armor for a coin, nothing else.

oath-of-order.name: Oath of Order
oath-of-order.text: Attach to unit. This unit gains Guard.
oath-of-order.designerNote: 2026-07-13 (designer, PR #52 — yellow rebalance pass, issue #50): the +1 Power rider is cut; Guard alone for 1. Notable under the proposed #50 rework, where Guard becomes the only bodyguard.

vanguard-sentinel.name: Vanguard Sentinel
vanguard-sentinel.text: Guard. When this unit dies, gain 1 Influence.
vanguard-sentinel.designerNote:
Decision 34: influence is earned by events, never by existing — this unit pays out when it defends (is attacked).

2026-07-12 (decision 85, issues #25/#24 — designer: "yes, push these up"): door 2 (retaliation)
became law and yellow's repair pass landed with it — guard defend-payouts up one notch (they now
trigger whether the guard blocks OR is attacked directly), wall power up one point (a wall's power
is also its retaliation now). ⚑ ratify/veto per card.

2026-07-13 (designer, PR #54 — yellow rebalance pass, issue #50): 1/2 → 1/1, and the defend
payout becomes a death payout — "When this unit dies, gain 1 Influence." New vocabulary:
`onDeath` trigger (fires as the unit falls, its owner collects). The martyr, not the sentry.

modes.label: Weak
modes.text: Exhaust an enemy unit with 4 or less Power.

modes.label: Cheap
modes.text: Exhaust an enemy unit that costs 4 or less.

modes.label: Overwhelm
modes.text: Exhaust any enemy unit — requires 8 or more Influence.

binding-light.name: Binding Light
binding-light.text: Choose one — exhaust an enemy unit with 4 or less Power; exhaust an enemy unit that costs 4 or less; or, if you have 8 or more Influence, exhaust any enemy unit.
binding-light.designerNote:
Session 006, prison ladder: Binding Light 2 = midweight lockup, pure tempo (no influence rider). The old 10+ rider was dead text — prisoners already can't attack anything (decision 50 spirit).

2026-07-11 (v3 churn pass 3): prison dies (#9), Capture succeeds it. Rung 2: the verdict of stillness — exhaustion is the new soft lock (blocking costs ready units in v3, so this bites twice).

2026-07-15 (#87, Griff ratified — enemy-only confirmed): the single 'exhaust a ≤4-Power enemy' becomes **modal**, same cost 2 / one yellow pip. Choose one: **Weak** (exhaust an enemy with ≤4 Power — the original), **Cheap** (exhaust an enemy that costs ≤4 — a new angle: costly beaters can be low-power, cheap ones can hit hard, so the two filters catch different threats), or **Overwhelm** (exhaust ANY enemy — but only while you hold 8+ Influence, a reward for a commanding board). Two new primitives: `maxCost` on a target, and a `cond` that gates a whole mode's legality (Overwhelm isn't even offered below 8 Influence).

modes.label: Capture
modes.text: Capture target enemy unit with 2 or less Power.

containment-priest.name: Containment Priest
containment-priest.text: When this enters play, choose one: capture target enemy unit with 2 or less Power, or exhaust a damaged enemy unit.
containment-priest.designerNote:
Decision 51: the pick is deterministic (strongest eligible; ties go to the earliest arrival) and the text says so. Fires on deploy and on every move.

2026-07-11 (v3 churn pass 3): prison dies (#9), Capture succeeds it. The priest carries its own cell now — a targeted capture on entry (was auto-imprison).

2026-07-14 (PR #75, Griff — "little balancing"): the priest becomes modal — on entry, choose to capture a small (≤2 power) enemy OR stand a *damaged* enemy down (exhaust it). Uses the existing `mustBeDamaged` target and the game's first modal UNIT (the mode's ops now run on a unit's entry, mirroring modal actions). Body trimmed 2/3 → 2/2. ⚑ ratify/veto — flagging that "a unit that is damaged" is read as an *enemy* damaged unit (exhausting your own makes no sense).

disciplined-mind.name: Disciplined Mind
disciplined-mind.text: Attach to unit. This unit gets Armor 1. Draw a card.

hold-the-line.name: Hold the Line
hold-the-line.text: Choose a zone. Your units there gain Guard.
hold-the-line.designerNote:
Decision 52: "this zone" on an action means "choose a zone" — the text now says so.
2026-07-13 (agent pass, issue #55 — designer commission: "take a crack at modifying all Yellow cards"): the flat 'Gain 1 Influence' rider is cut (your Iron Plating direction, applied wholesale — influence should be earned at moments, not stapled to spells; this slows yellow's influence clock directly). ⚑ ratify/veto.

sunguard-defender.name: Sunguard Defender
sunguard-defender.text: Guard. Shielded. When this unit defends, gain 1 Influence.
sunguard-defender.designerNote:
Decision 34: influence is earned by events, never by existing — this unit pays out when it defends (is attacked).

2026-07-12 (decision 85, issues #25/#24 — designer: "yes, push these up"): door 2 (retaliation)
became law and yellow's repair pass landed with it — guard defend-payouts up one notch (they now
trigger whether the guard blocks OR is attacked directly), wall power up one point (a wall's power
is also its retaliation now). ⚑ ratify/veto per card.
2026-07-13 (agent pass, issue #55 — designer commission: "take a crack at modifying all Yellow cards"): payout ladder −1 (the decision-85 raise was priced against a bot that blocked randomly; the ladder-back probe measured red 34.5→40, and under the duel law every guard is premium). ⚑ ratify/veto.

bulwark-protector.name: Bulwark Protector
bulwark-protector.text: Guard. Armor 1. When this unit defends, gain 1 Influence.
bulwark-protector.designerNote:
Decision 34: influence is earned by events, never by existing — this unit pays out when it defends (is attacked).

2026-07-12 (decision 85, issues #25/#24 — designer: "yes, push these up"): door 2 (retaliation)
became law and yellow's repair pass landed with it — guard defend-payouts up one notch (they now
trigger whether the guard blocks OR is attacked directly), wall power up one point (a wall's power
is also its retaliation now). ⚑ ratify/veto per card.
2026-07-13 (agent pass, issue #55 — designer commission: "take a crack at modifying all Yellow cards"): payout ladder −1 (the decision-85 raise was priced against a bot that blocked randomly; the ladder-back probe measured red 34.5→40, and under the duel law every guard is premium). ⚑ ratify/veto.

chain-of-law.name: Chain of Law
chain-of-law.text: Attached unit has Guard and Armor 1.
chain-of-law.designerNote:
2026-07-11 (v3 churn pass 3): prison dies (#9), Capture succeeds it. Untargetable is purple's (as Hidden) now; the chain deputizes instead — Guard + Armor 1, and in v3 orphaned chains are salvageable (decision 67).
2026-07-13 (agent pass, issue #55 — designer commission: "take a crack at modifying all Yellow cards"): the flat 'Gain 1 Influence' rider is cut (your Iron Plating direction, applied wholesale — influence should be earned at moments, not stapled to spells; this slows yellow's influence clock directly). ⚑ ratify/veto.

justicar-enforcer.name: Justicar Enforcer
justicar-enforcer.text: Guard. When this defends, gain 2 Influence.
justicar-enforcer.designerNote:
Session 006 balance pass: payout restored to 2 — this is yellow's dedicated influence-engine guard (the vanilla walls pay 1). Sims: without real influence payouts yellow's second win axis never fires.

2026-07-12 (decision 85, issues #25/#24 — designer: "yes, push these up"): door 2 (retaliation)
became law and yellow's repair pass landed with it — guard defend-payouts up one notch (they now
trigger whether the guard blocks OR is attacked directly), wall power up one point (a wall's power
is also its retaliation now). ⚑ ratify/veto per card.
2026-07-13 (agent pass, issue #55 — designer commission: "take a crack at modifying all Yellow cards"): payout ladder −1 (the decision-85 raise was priced against a bot that blocked randomly; the ladder-back probe measured red 34.5→40, and under the duel law every guard is premium). ⚑ ratify/veto.

2026-07-15 (#91 balance pass — Griff: "do all the card cuts"): power 3 → 2 — the decision-85 retaliation point comes back now that decision 105 divides the pour; red's 3/3s survive the block. Defend payout untouched. Full pass: griffs-yellow 69.7% → 56.0% vs griffs-red (N=300). ⚑ ratify/veto.

noble-purifier.name: Noble Purifier
noble-purifier.text: When this kills a unit, gain 2 Influence.
noble-purifier.designerNote:
Decision 51 text (deterministic pick — it may be the attack target itself, which cancels the counter-punch).

2026-07-11 (v3 churn pass 3): prison dies (#9), Capture succeeds it. Purification through victory — righteous kills win the crowd (was auto-imprison on attack).

prison-warrant.name: Prison Warrant
prison-warrant.text: Target unit you control captures target damaged enemy unit or unit with 2 or less Health. Gain 1 Influence at the beginning of each round where the target unit is still captured.
prison-warrant.designerNote:
Session 006, the prison ladder (each imprison action now has one job): Warrant 1 = small fry. The old "in this zone" was meaningless from hand (decision 52 context) and an unrestricted 1-mana imprison embarrassed Detain at 6.

2026-07-11 (v3 churn pass 3): prison dies (#9), Capture succeeds it. Rung 1: the small warrant — a warden order (first by-capture card). The captive is held until your warden readies or falls.

2026-07-13 (designer, PR #53 — yellow rebalance pass, issue #50): 1 → 3, the power cap becomes
"damaged OR ≤2 health" (new target vocabulary `damagedOrMaxHealth`), and the flat on-play
influence becomes **1/round while the captive is held** (new capture `income` — pays at the
holder's owner's start step, decision-71: so from round 2 on). ⚑ Agent reading: "beginning of
each round" = your start step; the income dies with the holder (decision 92: so does the grip).

radiant-aegis.name: Radiant Aegis
radiant-aegis.text: Give a friendly unit a Shield. If your Influence is below 0, gain 2 Influence.
radiant-aegis.designerNote:
Session 006: 1 → 2 mana. Armor 2 blanks red's whole cheap-burn suite; at 1 mana it was the best card in the pool. The armor ladder: Aegis 2 (Armor 2, one unit), Radiant Wall 5 (Armor 3), Command Edict 7 (Armor 1, everyone).
2026-07-13 (agent pass, issue #55 — designer commission: "take a crack at modifying all Yellow cards"): the flat 'Gain 1 Influence' rider is cut (your Iron Plating direction, applied wholesale — influence should be earned at moments, not stapled to spells; this slows yellow's influence clock directly). ⚑ ratify/veto.
2026-07-14 (#79, ratified with Griff): the whole card is rebuilt off the armor ladder. Now 3 mana, two yellow pips. It no longer prints permanent Armor 2 — it grants a **Shield** (the one-time ward: the first hit is prevented, then the token is spent), a cleaner fit with yellow's defensive-tempo identity than a permanent stat bump. New rider, deliberately gated: **only when your Influence is below 0** do you gain 2 — a catch-up valve for when yellow has been pushed off the track, never a free stapled gain. Two new engine primitives: granting `shielded` now raises the real shield token (it was a no-op before — the keyword line displayed a ward that didn't exist), and the `influence` op can carry a `cond`.

sanctified-bastion.name: Sanctified Bastion
sanctified-bastion.text: This can't attack. Other friendly units in this zone have Armor 1.
sanctified-bastion.designerNote:
Session 006: the aura is now zone-local (was board-wide — a 3-mana wall quietly armoring the whole army from home). Walls protect what stands behind them.

2026-07-12 (decision 85, issues #25/#24 — designer: "yes, push these up"): door 2 (retaliation)
became law and yellow's repair pass landed with it — guard defend-payouts up one notch (they now
trigger whether the guard blocks OR is attacked directly), wall power up one point (a wall's power
is also its retaliation now). ⚑ ratify/veto per card.

2026-07-15 (#91 balance pass — Griff: "do all the card cuts"): health 6 → 4 — the Armor-1 aura is the card; the 6-health chassis made it unremovable. At 4 it dies to Volcanic Slam + chip. Full pass: griffs-yellow 69.7% → 56.0% vs griffs-red (N=300). ⚑ ratify/veto.

subjugate.name: Subjugate
subjugate.text: Attach to an enemy unit. While attached, it gets −1 Power for each pip in its cost.
subjugate.designerNote:
Session 006, prison ladder: Subjugate 3 = unrestricted imprison that leaves a mark — the prisoner comes back weaker. The old "if your Influence is 5 or less" condition was noise; the rider is now unconditional.

2026-07-11 (v3 churn pass 3): prison dies (#9), Capture succeeds it. Rung 3: the breaking — permanent humiliation instead of walls.
2026-07-13 (agent pass, issue #55 — designer commission: "take a crack at modifying all Yellow cards"): the flat 'Gain 1 Influence' rider is cut (your Iron Plating direction, applied wholesale — influence should be earned at moments, not stapled to spells; this slows yellow's influence clock directly). ⚑ ratify/veto.
2026-07-14 (PR #80, designer's rework — mechanic confirmed): action → upgrade, the game's first ENEMY-attaching upgrade. The breaking becomes a brand: it scales with the host's pedigree — Worldrender (3 pips) kneels for −3, a footsoldier for −1. Cost stays 3 with two yellow pips (ruling: the PR's one-pip proposal was rejected). veilmaster.name: Veilmaster
veilmaster.designerNote:
Session 006 proposal: The lord of the color: the whole court starts shooting across zones.

2026-07-12 (decision 80, issue #24 Q9 — designer's charter, agent redesign ⚑ ratify/veto): Ranged
reborn as an ability action ("exhaust: deal N to one enemy unit in any zone") with ordinary attacks;
purple keeps two archers and the rest of the court re-identifies around non-attack keywords. THIS card: aura grants Hidden instead of Ranged — the Veilmaster veils the court. Flagged as the boldest of the set: a mass-Hidden aura is purple-defining; veto freely.
